rules.name: Unlimited Liability
rules.message: Clause appears to impose uncapped liability.
rules.recommendation: Add a clear liability cap or carve-out limits aligned with company policy.

rules.name: Broad Indemnity
rules.recommendation: Narrow indemnity scope to specific third-party claims and negotiated caps.

rules.name: Unilateral Change
rules.message: Clause allows one-sided changes with limited notice.
rules.recommendation: Require mutual written agreement or a defined advance notice period.

rules.name: Automatic Renewal
rules.recommendation: Add a reminder window and explicit opt-out notice language.

rules.name: Immediate Termination
rules.message: Clause permits immediate or convenience-based termination.
rules.recommendation: Limit immediate termination to material breach and add cure periods where possible.
